title: AFKK
description: Real AFK detection with anti-fake rewards, AFK tab tags, and clean server-friendly logic.
body:
# ![moon](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f4a4.svg) AFKK

AFKK is a lightweight AFK system for Paper/Spigot servers focused on **real AFK detection**, not fake farm abuse.

## ![sparkles](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2728.svg) Core Features
- ![brain](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f9e0.svg) Real inactivity AFK detection (time + action tracking)
- ![no_entry](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/26d4.svg) Anti-fake AFK logic (micro movement spam protection)
- ![gift](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f381.svg) Configurable AFK rewards on interval
- ![label](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f3f7.svg) `[AFK]` tag in TAB and in-game display name
- ![gear](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2699.svg) Admin controls and reload support

---

## ![package](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f4e6.svg) Requirements
- Java **17+**
- Minecraft server supporting 1.20+ API line
- Recommended: **Paper 1.20.4+**

---

## ![puzzle](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f9e9.svg) Plugin Dependencies
- **Required dependencies:** None
- **Soft dependencies:** None
- Works standalone out of the box

---

## ![tools](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f6e0.svg) Compatible Server Software
- Paper
- Purpur
- Spigot
- Bukkit
- Folia

---

## ![keyboard](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2328.svg) Commands
```text
/afk
/afk status [player]
/afk list
/afk reload
```

## ![shield](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f6e1.svg) Permissions
```text
trueafk.use
trueafk.admin
trueafk.bypass
```

---

## ![sliders](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f39b.svg) Config Highlights
- `afk.idle-seconds`
- `afk.micro-action-window-seconds`
- `afk.micro-action-limit`
- `rewards.interval-seconds`
- `rewards.commands`
- `tag.text`, `tag.position`

---

## ![bulb](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f4a1.svg) Recommended Reward Commands
```yml
rewards:
  commands:
    - "xp add {player} 1 levels"
```

---
